info.name: Mews Booking Engine API (Distributor) Account notes Voucher codes API

items.docs: Adds voucher codes to the specified [Vouchers](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/vouchers/#voucher). Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).
Delete specified voucher codes. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).

Returns all voucher codes filtered by [Voucher](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/vouchers/#voucher) or other filter parameters. Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).
